name: maya-inbound-mpl-agegender
notes: Returning caller whose profile carries age+gender (e.g. +91XXXXXX0942). Asserts: MPL offered once; age/gender NOT re-asked; at least one apply succeeds. The age/gender checks assume the caller's profile has those fields — true for the +91 96672 test number; adjust per test caller.

checks.desc: MPL Competition must be offered once per call
age must NOT be asked (profile carries it)
gender must NOT be asked (profile carries it)
at least one apply must actually succeed
